title: Event modal fields all save; the all-day toggle creates an all-day event
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. You are on the Schedule page with the event modal open (via right-click 'Create Event').
custom_steps:
1. Read the fields the modal offers.
2. Fill each: name, date, start and end time, and pick a color category. Save, then re-open the event.
3. Open the event modal again, turn the all-day toggle ON, and save.
4. Look at how the all-day event renders in day and week views.
custom_expected:
1. The modal contains: name, date, start/end time, an all-day toggle, and a color category.
2. The event saves with the entered values.
3. Re-opening the event shows the saved values.
4. With all-day ON, specific start/end times are not required (the time fields are disabled or hidden).
5. The event is created as an all-day block for that technician and day.
